training.title: Education and Experience
training.subtitle: At Fundación Kinal, diversified IT major
training.startText: I began my programming education with introductory Java and, toward the end of that year, I gained fundamental knowledge of relational databases using MySQL.
training.consolidationText: During this year I became familiar with XAMPP, Apache Tomcat, and Postman for running and testing APIs. I also worked with JavaFX for graphical interfaces and used Git for version control and project management. In addition, I completed certification programs on Platzi and earned the following diplomas:
training.consolidationList: Basic Java, Object-Oriented Programming in Java, Persistence with Java, Java and SQL, SQL and MySQL
training.fullstackTitle: First steps into full stack development
training.fullstackText: I entered the JavaScript ecosystem, adding Node.js for backend development, MongoDB as a NoSQL database, and React for the frontend, strengthening key modern web development skills. I also learned how to deploy projects to the cloud using MongoDB Atlas.
training.practiceTitle: Internship experience at Tribal Worldwide Guatemala
training.practiceText: My experience at Tribal Worldwide Guatemala, where I completed 400 hours of professional practice, was highly enriching and helped me strengthen both technical and soft skills. From the first days I received onboarding to the work environment and access to tools such as Clockify, corporate email, Jira, and Discord, as well as internal documentation such as “HU & PR's Documentation” and “Backend Devs Onboarding”. During the process, I deepened my use of PHP and Laravel, joined a project with repository access, and set up the development environment using Ubuntu and Docker to run and manage the required services. I worked on project changes, managing commits and pull requests to reflect updates in the repositories, and I attended the office twice (the main modality was virtual). Additionally, I reinforced my algorithm knowledge, solved a technical assessment designed by my supervisor to measure intern logic, and researched state management patterns to help improve the project architecture.
